_comment: Commander bracket rules. Sources: the Commander Format Panel bracket system, introduced at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/introducing-commander-brackets-beta (2025-02-11), revised at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/commander-brackets-beta-update-october-21-2025 (2025-10-21), and updated at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/commander-brackets-beta-update-february-9-2026 (2026-02-09). The three URLs were fetched on 2026-08-29 and carry those titles and dates. The expected_turns values match the 2025-10-21 revision. The max_game_changers values come from the original article and were not re-read from the two later articles on 2026-08-29: unverified against them. Only the machine-checkable parts live here (F-11). The prose parts (mass land denial, extra-turn chains, combo timing) are not encoded yet: the engine emits an info finding that names them. A Game Changer commander counts as one of the three at Bracket 3, and can not play in Brackets 1 and 2 (the engine counts the command zone, D-60). verified_at is the date of the last full check. -1 means no limit.
